passage_intro: Now, let's read. Listen and repeat.

phrases.en: I love reading, and I love a good book.
phrases.ko: 나는 책 읽기를 아주 좋아하고, 좋은 책도 아주 좋아해요.

phrases.en: I sit in a quiet place.
I like to read a story at night.
phrases.ko: 나는 밤에 이야기를 읽는 것을 좋아해요.

phrases.en: I go to the library, and reading makes me happy.
phrases.ko: 나는 도서관에 가고, 책 읽기는 나를 행복하게 해요.

phrases.en: A quiet room and a lamp are enough.
Each story gives me a new word.
I love reading with my little sister.
phrases.ko: 나는 여동생과 함께 책 읽기를 아주 좋아해요.

phrases.en: The library has more books than my room.
phrases.ko: 도서관에는 내 방보다 책이 더 많아요.

phrases.en: At night a happy reader closes the book slowly.
phrases.ko: 밤에 행복한 독자는 책을 천천히 덮어요.

full_passage_spoken: I love reading, and I love a good book. I sit in a quiet place. I like to read a story at night. The lamp is on. I learn a new word. I go to the library, and reading makes me happy. A quiet room and a lamp are enough. Each story gives me a new word. I love reading with my little sister. The library has more books than my room. At night a happy reader closes the book slowly.
